(2) A sequence follows showing her as the Powerpuff Girls in a living room, then as a muscular man in a field, and a woman in a yellow gown in a park. (3) She transitions into historical and anime characters like Levi from Attack on Titan and Mulan in a garden. (5) She cosplays Sailor Moon with graphic lighting effects, characters from Spirited Away, and a used car dealer on a street. (8) The video concludes with her as a chef, a breakfast shop lady, and characters from 'The Incredibles' and 'Squid Game' in various themed indoor and outdoor environments.
